items.consequence: When this snippet is sourced before `compinit` has defined `compdef`—a possible ordering in `.zshrc`—this branch calls `_rg` immediately at startup instead of registering it. That runs completion logic outside the completion system and produces an error (for example, `_arguments: command not found`); avoid invoking `_rg` for this sourcing case or document that the snippet must come after `compinit`.
